title: Away-day requests to a weekly watering rota

goal.text: Every plot is watered every day of a dry week, even when its holder is away, without hand-built rotas.

agent_checkable.target: every plot, every day of the week
agent_checkable.check: A script counts rows per plot and day (Q01).

agent_checkable.metric: Rows that put someone on a day they are away
agent_checkable.check: The critic compares every row with the requests (Q02).

outcome.metric: Plot holders reporting a forgotten plot

users_and_stakeholders.interest: Reads the rota and waters on their days.
Approves the rota before it reaches the sheet.
The watering work is shared fairly.

steps: Plot holders send away-days by message.
The rota keeper copies them onto paper.
The week is built by hand.
problems: The same few people water most days.

in: One week's away-day requests in, one watering rota out, written to the rota sheet after approval.

inputs.format: plain text, one request per line

glossary.meaning: A day a plot holder cannot water, given in their request.

acceptance_tests.words: a whole dry week goes by and no plot holder tells me their plot was forgotten.
cites: [A:A08 "a whole dry week goes by and no plot holder tells me their plot was forgotten."]

context_inventory.evidence_for: What a week's requests look like; source of the sample rows.

cites: [A:A12 "The requests are made up for testing."]

confidence.high: The row quotes the request line that decided it.
confidence.medium: Not used: every row needs its request line.
confidence.low: Not used: a row without a request line is left out and raised as a question.

conflicts: If two requests for one plot disagree, report both to the rota keeper; never pick one silently.

output.description: One row per day and plot.
output.format: Table, rendered by a script from the validated rota

fields.name: waterer
fields.description: A plot holder's first name from the requests.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The request line that decided the row, quoted.

rules.statement: Every plot is watered every day of the week.
cites: [A:A07 "Every plot is watered every day; missing one is a blocker."]

rules.statement: Nobody waters on a day they are away.
cites: [A:A07 "Nobody waters on a day they are away; major."]

rules.statement: Nobody waters more than two days a week.
cites: [A:A07 "Nobody waters more than two days a week; major."]

rules.statement: Each row quotes the request that decided it.
cites: [A:A07 "Each row quotes the request that decided it; minor."]

definitions: A week runs Monday to Sunday; a waterer's days are counted across all plots they water.

good.text: 2099-07-06 | Plot 4 | Cleo | Plot 4, Ada, away Mon-Wed
2099-07-09 | Plot 4 | Ada | Plot 4, Ada, away Mon-Wed

bad.text: 2099-07-07 | Plot 4 | Ada | Plot 4, Ada, away Mon-Wed
A week with no row for Plot 7 on 2099-07-08.

risk.notes: People act on the sheet at once; the sheet can be corrected, a lost watering day cannot.

gates.decision: Approve or reject the reviewed draft rota.
Confirm writing the approved rota to the rota sheet.
cites: [A:A11 "I confirm again right before anything goes on the sheet."]
[A:A11 "fifteen agent calls a job is plenty."]

open_questions.question: Do two plots sharing one water butt count as one plot?

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The rota writer and critic meet the evaluation thresholds on synthetic request lists.
Nothing reaches the rota sheet without the G2 confirmation.
